'''Thorn Maw''' was a [[Esh-kha savant]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was freed from imprisonment in [[the Tomb]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Thorn Maw was among the [[Esh-kha]] warriors who took over the canyon known as [[the Scar]], but was [[Death/Legends|slain]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thorn Maw is the target of the final stage of "Prison Scars," an Area mission for Republic players on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
